title: Open-source karpathy-output-style implements visual output ladder for AI agents
summary: The open-source karpathy-output-style repository packages Andrej Karpathy's visual explanation hierarchy into reusable agent skills, enabling coding assistants to produce Excalidraw diagrams, interactive single-file HTML pages, and narrated video animations instead of standard text.
research_notes:
Clone the karpathy-output-style repository or copy the skill definition file into the agent configuration directory.

Configure the agent runtime (such as Claude Code or Codex) to load the skill rules during query execution.

Prompt the agent with a concept or code explanation task, allowing the skill to select between simplified technical text, Excalidraw diagrams, interactive HTML, or explainer video formats.

Follow the four-tier ladder strictly by defaulting to the simplest format before requesting heavy interactive HTML or video artifacts.

Ensure interactive HTML outputs are fully self-contained in a single file with embedded styles and scripts to permit instant local browser inspection.
